mainEntity.name: When do I need to hire an architect versus a general contractor for my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: You typically hire an architect early in the process for significant design work, such as new home builds or major additions, to develop detailed plans. A general contractor, like Hometelligent Inc., is usually brought in after conceptual designs are firm, often during the bidding or pre-construction phase, to manage the actual building process. The decision to hire an architect depends on the complexity of your design needs; a general contractor can sometimes provide design-build services for simpler projects.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire an architect for detailed design on complex projects, and a general contractor for construction management after designs are firm. Design complexity guides this decision.
